## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `IdentityAccessManagement`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `identity-and-access-management`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **IdentityAccessManagement**.

## Step 2: Add credentials to agents

1. In the visual designer, select **Agent** node to open the configuration panel. Then, expand **Advanced configuration**.
2. <!-- manual: Provide the Agent ID and Agent Secret obtained from the authorization server. -->

## Step 3: Configure auth for an MCP tool

1. <!-- manual: Click on the attached MCP Toolkit in the agent to open the configuration form. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the Auth Configuration Panel, select the authentication type as AgentIdAuthConfig and update the values obtained from the authorization server. -->
3. In the same form, go to **Tools to Include** and select **Selected**.
4. <!-- manual: Navigate to Available Tools, select the required tools, and click on the Secure Access (Shield) icon of the specific tool and add the scopes. -->

## Step 4: Configure auth for Non-MCP tool

1. Select **3-dot menu** and.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. <!-- manual: Go to the Advanced Configuration, click Expand and fill the form with the values obtained from the authorization server. -->
4. Select **Save**.
